hints.content:
### Definition of sine

For an angle with measure $\theta$ in a right triangle:

$\sin(\theta)=\dfrac{\blueE{\text{opposite leg length}}}{\purpleD{\text{hypotenuse length}}}$

### Identifying the hypotenuse and the side opposite to $\angle A$

The side $\blueE{\text{opposite}}$ to $\angle A$ is $\overline{BC}$ and its length is $\blueE{20}$ units.

The $\purpleD{\text{hypotenuse}}$ is $\overline{AB}$ and its length is $\purpleD{29}$ units.
